filter: Pooled IN-cluster magnitude_rank<=0.05, any endpoint-specific unambiguous saved DESeq2 padj<0.05, >=3 supporting WT and >=3 supporting cKO mice, IN identity review REFERENCE_SUPPORTED, native CPDB specificity P<=0.05
selection: Four diverse manually selected examples per CA1 program/direction quadrant, selected from the filtered table; not a new composite ranking or exhaustive discovery list
localization_caveat: Excluded Rims1–Cacna1c from interpreted extracellular shortlist because Rims1 is a presynaptic cytoplasmic scaffold; native full exports unchanged. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/gene/116837/
DESeq2_effect_reference: signed log2(cKO/WT) of the exact gene and matching existing population endpoint
symmetric_contact_caveat: Reversed Nlgn/Nrxn orientations can share exact expression scores; these are prior orientations, not independent demonstrations of physiological signaling direction.
distinction: The 16-record table uses native CellPhoneDB specificity P<=0.05, not consensus specificity_rank<=0.05. Some examples (e.g. Slit3-Robo1) therefore do not qualify for the stronger consensus-specific tier.
